rationale: The FHIR-IG site publisher (scripts/stage-local-ig.ts): it builds an IG repository with the reusable workflow it calls (fhirbuild.yml / ghbuild.yml) and lays the output where that workflow's deploy step does, or publishes the folio site with the IG at its root. cat-harness-tools' stage-local.ts reaches it through this slot, found among the dependencies of the repository being published, and names no layer above its own (owner, 2026-10-14, Q4).
